```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(patchwork)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 18)) #for ggplot

```

```{r}
dac <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "Dactylis_Demography_Data_CLEANED_2016thru2025.csv"))
climate <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "CGOP_climatevalues_scaled.csv"))
climate<- climate %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(across(-year, ~lag(.x), .names = "prev_{.col}")) %>% 
  select(c(year, winter.mean.min.temp, prev_winter.mean.min.temp, summer.mean.max.temp, prev_summer.mean.max.temp, spring.mean.temp, prev_spring.mean.temp, fall.mean.temp, prev_fall.mean.temp, ends_with("tot.precip")))

dac <- left_join(dac, climate, by = c("Year" = "year"))
dac <- dac %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year), 
         Plot = as.factor(Plot),
         survT = as.factor(survT),
         survT1 = as.factor(survT1),
         pflowerT = as.factor(pflowerT),
         pflowerT1 = as.factor(pflowerT1),
         log.no.stems = log(No.stems),
         log.no.stemsT1 = log(No.stemsT1),
        trt = as.factor(trt),
        trt = fct_relevel(trt, "irrigated", "control", "drought"))

dac <- dac %>% 
  filter(!(Plot %in% c("4", "5", "15")))
```

```{r ground truthing lambda}
lam <- dac %>%
 # filter(Xcoor < 10) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(as.character(Year))) %>%  # fix ordering
  group_by(Year, Plot) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(survT == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Plot, Year) %>%
  group_by(Plot) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda = lead(n) / n
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
(lambda <- ggplot(lam, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = lambda, color = Plot)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1)+
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression(lambda)) +
  theme_minimal())
(n <- ggplot(lam, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = n, color = Plot)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of plants") +
  theme_minimal())
(to <- lambda/n +plot_layout(guides = "collect")
)
ggsave(here("Figures", "Dactylis", "groundtruth.lambda.png"), plot = to, width = 8, height =6)

```

```{r what size metric to use, and for pflower}
#whats a better size measurement - log(no.stems *height) or log(no.stems)?
size.test1 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac, REML = F)
size.test2 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log(No.stems*Height) + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac, REML = F)
AIC(size.test1, size.test2)
#first one

#size in current year or past year for flowering
dac_complete <- dac[complete.cases(dac[, c("pflowerT", "pflowerT1", "log.no.stems", "Year", "Plot")]), ]
f.test1  <- glmer(pflowerT ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Year) + (1|Plot) , data = dac_complete, family = "binomial")
f.test2  <- glmer(pflowerT1 ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Year) + (1|Plot) , data = dac_complete, family = "binomial")
AIC(f.test1, f.test2) #one is better

table(dac$survT1, dac$Year)
table(dac$pflowerT, dac$Year)
table(dac$stage, dac$Year)
table(dac$No.panicles, dac$Year)

summary_df <- dac %>%
  group_by(Plot, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    panciles_t = sum(No.panicles, na.rm = TRUE),
    seedlings_t = sum(stage=="seedling", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
summary_df
t_t1_table <- t_t1_table %>%
  mutate(seedlings_per_panicle = ifelse(
    panciles_t == 0 | is.na(panciles_t) | is.na(seedlings_t1),
    NA,
    seedlings_t1 / panciles_t
  ))
mean_seedlings_per_panicle <- mean(
  t_t1_table$seedlings_per_panicle,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
#0.096
```

```{r growth prequel}
base <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems*Year + (1|Plot), data = dac, REML = F)
drop1(base,test="Chisq")
base2 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems+Year + (1|Plot), data = dac, REML = F)
base3 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Plot), data = dac, REML = F)
a2 <- anova(base3, base2, test="LRT") #yes year is significant
best.growth <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems + (1|Year) + (1|Plot), data = dac, REML = F)

re_year <- rownames_to_column(
  as.data.frame(ranef(best.growth)$Year),
  var = "year") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

# 
grow.corr <- left_join(re_year, climate) %>% 
  select(-year)
names(grow.corr)[names(grow.corr) == "(Intercept)"] <- "int"
cor_matrix <- cor(grow.corr)
correlations <- cor_matrix[,"int"]

correlations <- correlations[names(correlations) != "int"]
correlations_sorted <- sort(correlations, decreasing = TRUE)
###
vars <- names(grow.corr)[names(grow.corr) != "int"]

# Compute correlations and p-values
cor_results <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  test <- cor.test(grow.corr$int, grow.corr[[v]])
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

# Combine into one data frame
cor_results_growth <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)

# Sort by absolute correlation
cor_results_growth <- cor_results_growth[order(-abs(cor_results_growth$correlation)), ]
#summer tot.precip only with with correlation
```

```{r pflower prequel}
#base.p1 <- glmer(pflowerT ~ log.no.stems*as.numeric(Year) + (1|Plot) , data = dac, family = "binomial")
base.p <- glmer(pflowerT ~ log.no.stems*Year + (1|Plot) , data = dac, family = "binomial")
#t <- AIC(base.p, base.p1)

drop1(base.p,test="Chisq") #nope interaction not significant
base.p2 <- glmer(pflowerT ~ log.no.stems+Year + (1|Plot) , data = dac, family = "binomial")
base.p3 <- glmer(pflowerT ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Plot), data = dac, family = "binomial")
a2 <- anova(base.p3, base.p2, test="LRT") #yes year is significant
best.pflower <- glmer(pflowerT ~ log.no.stems + (1|Year) + (1|Plot), data = dac, family = "binomial")


re_year <- rownames_to_column(
  as.data.frame(ranef(best.pflower)$Year),
  var = "year") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

pflower.corr <- left_join(re_year, climate) %>% 
  select(-year)
names(pflower.corr)[names(pflower.corr) == "(Intercept)"] <- "int"
cor_matrix <- cor(pflower.corr)
correlations <- cor_matrix[,"int"]

# Optional: remove int itself
correlations <- correlations[names(correlations) != "int"]

correlations_sorted <- sort(correlations, decreasing = TRUE)
###
vars <- names(pflower.corr)[names(pflower.corr) != "int"]

# get correlations and p-values
cor_results <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  test <- cor.test(pflower.corr$int, pflower.corr[[v]])
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

# Combine into one data frame
cor_results_pflower <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)

# Sort by absolute correlation
cor_results_pflower <- cor_results_pflower[order(-abs(cor_results_pflower$correlation)), ]

```

```{r survival prequel}
dac.survival <- dac %>% 
  filter(Year!= "2024",
         Year!= "2025")
table(dac.survival$survT1, dac.survival$Year)
base.s <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*Year + (1|Plot) , data = dac.survival, family = "binomial", control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
drop1(base.s,test="Chisq") #yes, keep size*climate interactions
#base.p2 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems+Year + (1|Plot) , data = dac, family = "binomial", control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
#base.p3 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Plot), data = dac, family = "binomial")
#a2 <- anova(base.p3, base.p2, test="LRT") #yes year is significant
best.s <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + (1|Year) + (1|Plot) , data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")

re_year <- rownames_to_column(
  as.data.frame(ranef(best.s)$Year),
  var = "year") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

surv.corr <- left_join(re_year, climate) %>% 
  select(-year)
names(surv.corr)[names(surv.corr) == "(Intercept)"] <- "int"
cor_matrix <- cor(surv.corr)
correlations <- cor_matrix[,"int"]

# Optional: remove int itself
correlations <- correlations[names(correlations) != "int"]

correlations_sorted <- sort(correlations, decreasing = TRUE)
###
vars <- names(surv.corr)[names(surv.corr) != "int"]

# get correlations and p-values
cor_results <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  test <- cor.test(surv.corr$int, surv.corr[[v]])
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

# Combine into one data frame
cor_results_surv <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)

# Sort by absolute correlation
cor_results_surv <- cor_results_surv[order(-abs(cor_results_surv$correlation)), ]
cor_results_surv
```

```{r survival model selection}
sm.base.size <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.base.trt <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems+ trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.base.trt.int <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")

#grow season ave temp
sm.prev_spring.mean.temp <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + prev_spring.mean.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.prev_spring.mean.temp.int <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*prev_spring.mean.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.prev_spring.mean.temp.trt <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + prev_spring.mean.temp + trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.prev_spring.mean.temptrt.int <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + prev_spring.mean.temp*trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.prev_spring.mean.temptrt.int2 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*trt + prev_spring.mean.temp+ (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")

#prev.winter
sm.winter.mean.min.temp <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + winter.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.winter.mean.min.temp.int <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*winter.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.winter.mean.min.temp.trt <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + winter.mean.min.temp + trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.winter.mean.min.temp.trt.int <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + winter.mean.min.temp*trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.winter.mean.min.temp.trt.int2 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*trt + winter.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")

#both prev winter and spring
sm.wt.sp <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + prev_spring.mean.temp + winter.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.wt.sp.int <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*prev_spring.mean.temp + winter.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.wt.sp.int2 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*winter.mean.min.temp + prev_spring.mean.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.wt.sp.trt <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + prev_spring.mean.temp + trt + winter.mean.min.temp+(1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.wt.sp.trt.int <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + prev_spring.mean.temp*trt +winter.mean.min.temp+ (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.wt.sp.trt.int2 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems + winter.mean.min.temp*trt +prev_spring.mean.temp+ (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.wt.sp.trt.int3 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*prev_spring.mean.temp+trt+winter.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.wt.sp.trt.int4 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*winter.mean.min.temp + prev_spring.mean.temp + trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.wt.sp.trt.int5 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems+winter.mean.min.temp + prev_spring.mean.temp*trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
sm.wt.sp.trt.int6 <- glmer(survT1 ~ log.no.stems*trt+winter.mean.min.temp + prev_spring.mean.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac.survival, family = "binomial")
```

```{r number panicles figure}
(pan <- dac %>% 
    filter(pflowerT == "1") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log.no.stems, y = No.panicles))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.25, shape = 1, height = .05, width = 0.05)+
  geom_line(data = pred.dat.output.pan, aes(y = No.panicles, color = factor(prev_spring.mean.temp)),linewidth = 1.5) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 1.1), legend.position = "bottom")+
  scale_color_manual(name = "Spring average temp in t-1", values = c("#00a3a3","#d72a96"), labels = c("cool", "warm")) +
  #scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5.25))+
  #scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5.25))+
  labs(x = "log(Number of Stems) in t", y = "Number of panicles in t"))

ggsave(here("Figures", "Dactylis", "pan.png"), plot = pan, width = 6, height =6)
```
